snippet.title: Dreamcards – Official Release Date Trailer | August 19, 2026
snippet.description:
Dreamcards launches on Steam on August 19, 2026.

Wishlist now and play the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726730/Dreamcards/

Dreamcards is a hand-drawn roguelike deckbuilder set inside the recurring dreams of a withdrawn protagonist known simply as Self.

Instead of warriors, weapons and spells, Self builds a deck from their own relationships and memories. Mother, Father, Best Friend, Lover, Sibling and Grandparent become Character cards, while shared experiences become Actions—each relationship shaping a different strategy and revealing a different part of Self’s past.

Revisit relationships by day, confront the ever-changing Monster Within by night, and overcome the Nightmare to reach a Lucid Dream. Discover Self’s memories without dialogue, narration or explanatory text through more than 200 hand-drawn illustrations and animations inspired by tarot imagery and Brazilian cordel literature.

Developed by Soneka Games, Published by Vsoo Games

#Dreamcards #IndieGame #Deckbuilder
